catchbook_deliverable: Helm feature board with milestones, labels, and initial issue backlog
description: Master GitHub's project management tools to organize and track Helm's development. Learn to write effective issues, configure labels and milestones, set up a Kanban board with GitHub Projects, and link issues to code through branches and PRs. By the end, Helm will have a structured, professional backlog ready to drive all future development.
learning_objectives: Understand the role of GitHub Issues in professional project management
Create well-structured issues for bugs, features, and tasks
Configure labels and milestones for organizing work
Set up a GitHub Projects Kanban board for Helm
Link issues to branches and PRs using GitHub keywords
Use auto-close syntax (Closes #N) to keep the board current
Build and prioritize Helm's initial feature backlog

lessons.title: GitHub Issues 101 — Labels, Milestones, and Assignees

Linking Issues to Code — Branches, PRs, and Auto-Close
